meta.title: Mage per-level character data for WoW Forever, Alliance races, levels 1-60

status_legend.forever: Forever client data (or a wowsims-forever value read in the Forever game)

meta.layout: levels.<stat> holds class-wide arrays; races.<race>.levels.<stat> holds the attribute arrays and naked totals for that race. Every array is indexed by level-1 (index 0 = level 1). Every entry: {level, value, status, source}; source is a key of meta.sources or an inline formula. Mob baselines are not repeated here (data/shaman_levels.json mobs).

sources.PES: Forever client DB2 PlayerExpectedStat (ContentSetID 0), build 1.60.1.70862, wago.tools CSV (ext/wago/PlayerExpectedStat_70862.csv). wowsims-forever tools/base_stats_parser.py reads the same table for its level 60 values.
sources.CM_CLS: cmangos classic-db Full_DB/ClassicDB_1_12_1_z2815.sql.gz player_classlevelstats (vanilla 1.12 base health and mana)
sources.CM_LVL: cmangos classic-db player_levelstats: the class row is, per level and attribute, the value the vanilla races give after subtracting each race's offset (the Human spirit and Gnome intellect rows are left out: cmangos bakes their vanilla +5% racial into the row). Where races disagree, the AzerothCore player_class_stats value (ext/ac/player_class_stats.sql) when one race also gives it, else the most common. AzerothCore's class rows equal the result at every level of every class except the entries listed in meta.class_row_dissent.
sources.WS_OFF: wowsims-forever sim/core/base_stats.go RaceOffsets (vanilla races: the same offsets cmangos rows give at every level, checked in meta.race_offsets_check)
sources.WS_SKY: wowsims-forever sim/core/base_stats.go RaceOffsets[RaceHighOrderSkyborne] Str -3, Agi +4, Sta -1, Int +4, Spi -3, 'read from level 1 naked character sheets (2026-11-06)'. A Forever in-game reading at level 1 only; carried to every level on the vanilla rule that a race offset is the same at every level. Every Skyborne attribute is marked estimate: the class row is vanilla and the source does not say which classes' sheets were read.
sources.WS_BASE: wowsims-forever sim/core/base_stats_auto_gen.go ExtraClassBaseStats (from the hand-kept assets/db_inputs/basestats/chancetomeleecritbase.txt and chancetospellcritbase.txt, vanilla tables; the game files ship none) and base_stats.go ClassBaseDodge
sources.VM_STAT: vmangos src/game/StatSystem.cpp (Player::UpdateCritPercentage / UpdateDodgePercentage base values, UpdateParryPercentage / UpdateBlockPercentage 5% base, GetHealthBonusFromStamina, GetManaBonusFromIntellect)
sources.VM_REGEN: vmangos src/game/Objects/Unit.cpp Unit::GetRegenMPPerSpirit / GetRegenHPPerSpirit (values per 2 s regen tick; Player::Regenerate comments: 'Mangos Updates Mana in intervals of 2s')

meta.race_offsets_check: With wowsims RaceOffsets (Str,Agi,Sta,Int,Spi: Human 0, Orc 3,-3,2,-3,3, Dwarf 2,-4,3,-1,-1, Night Elf -3,5,-1,0,0, Undead -1,-2,1,-2,5, Tauren 5,-5,2,-5,2, Gnome -5,3,-1,3,0, Troll 1,2,1,-4,1) every cmangos race row of this class minus its offset gives one class row, except the entries in class_row_dissent (Human spirit and Gnome intellect are excluded up front because cmangos bakes the vanilla +5% racial into them).

attack_power.rule_check: wowsims-forever base AP at 60 = the vanilla level term at 60 (ClassBaseStats.AttackPower); the stat links in sim/mage/mage.go add the Str/Agi terms. mythicsim levels.rs scales a positive level 60 base as (AP60 + 20)/60*L - 20, which equals the vanilla level term for every class here.

meta.spell_power: No class has base spell power or spell power from attributes in either source. Spell power from attributes comes only from talents (wowsims-forever: Hunter Careful Aim Int->AP, Priest Spiritual Guidance-type Spirit->spell damage/healing in talents_holy.go, Paladin Champion of the Light Int->spell damage, Shaman Mental Dexterity Int->AP, Warlock Demonic Knowledge). Talents are out of scope for this file.

regen.mana_vanilla: (Spirit/4 + 12.5) mana per 2 s tick = 6.25 + Spirit/8 per second, no level term (VM_REGEN). Regen from Spirit stops for 5 s after a mana spend (vmangos Player::Regenerate IsUnderLastManaUseEffect uses the interrupted rate, which is 0 without an aura).
regen.mana_wowsims_forever: 6.25 + Spirit/8 mana per second for every class, no level term (WS_REGEN). It equals the vanilla Mage/Priest formula; for other mana classes it differs from vanilla. While casting, Spirit regen x PseudoStats.SpiritRegenRateCasting (0 by default). Not checked below 60.
regen.health_ooc_vanilla: max(0, Spirit*0.11 +1) per 2 s tick out of combat, x1.5 sitting, none in combat (vmangos Player::RegenerateHealth / Unit::GetRegenHPPerSpirit). No Forever source; wowsims-forever has no health regeneration.

meta.health_mana_formulas: max health = base_health + min(Sta,20) + hp_per_stamina*max(Sta-20,0); max mana = base_mana + min(Int,20) + 15*max(Int-20,0) (vmangos GetHealthBonusFromStamina / GetManaBonusFromIntellect; wowsims-forever the same). *_naked arrays use naked attributes, no racial or talent modifiers.

racials_alliance_wowsims.human: The Human Spirit: Spirit x1.1 (wowsims racials.go; its TODO says the game build still states 5% for 20598 and the 26 Oct notes set 10%); Ruthless: +1% melee and spell crit (game build states 2% for 20597).
racials_alliance_wowsims.dwarf: Artisan's Precision: +1% melee and spell hit (new in Forever); +5% damage vs Beasts (Big Game Hunter); Stoneform: -10% physical damage taken for 8 s, 3 min cooldown.
racials_alliance_wowsims.night_elf: Quickness: +1% base dodge; +2% movement speed; Elune's Light: +10% melee and spell crit for 15 s, 3 min cooldown (new in Forever).
racials_alliance_wowsims.gnome: Expansive Mind (Forever): +5% maximum rage (Warrior), energy (Rogue) or mana (Priest, Mage, Warlock) in wowsims racials.go applyExpansiveMind (vanilla was +5% Intellect); Eureka! (new) cost/damage proc rows 1259812-1259821.
racials_alliance_wowsims.high_order_skyborne: Wind Blessed: x1.02 attack and cast speed (wowsims; its TODO: notes say 2%, the build states 3% for 1259710; Blizzard's race page says 1% haste); Elemental Insight: +5% damage vs Elementals; Read Ley Line (Energized): mana regen x1.5 (x2 Attuned) for 15 s (build states 30 s, +100%).

gaps: Base health below 60 is single-source vanilla (cmangos player_classlevelstats); the Forever client has no player base-health table. Level 60 is cross-checked against wowsims (see checks).
Base melee/spell crit and base dodge are hand-kept vanilla tables (wowsims assets/db_inputs/basestats, vmangos); the Forever client ships none.

Dodge per Agility below 60: no Forever or local vanilla per-level table (vmangos reads player_dodge_per_agility from its world DB, not in the local source); wowsims's level 60 rule (= crit per Agility, x2 Rogue/Hunter) is carried to every level as an estimate.
Spirit mana regen below 60 and health regen: no Forever source; both formulas carried unchanged.
Talent and racial modifiers are not applied in any *_naked value.

Base health: cmangos (used here) is 10 below wowsims SoD at levels 25, 40, 50 and 60 and below wowsims-forever at 60 (Priest 1387 vs 1397, Mage 1360 vs 1370). Unresolved; no Forever table exists. A sim that must match wowsims at 60 should add 10.

High Order Skyborne attributes: the race offset is a wowsims reading of level 1 naked sheets (which classes not stated); it is assumed constant at every level (estimate). No Skyborne row exists in any vanilla table.
